Port.title: Port
Port.description: Represents a maritime port or terminal where vessels can depart from or arrive at. Admin staff can manage these entries.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Port entity.

name.description: The official or common name of the port.

cityMunicipality.description: The city or municipality where the port is located.

province.description: The province where the port is located.

country.description: The country where the port is geographically located.

description.description: A brief description or additional information about the port facilities or location.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the port record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the port record was last updated.

definition.description: A top-level collection containing all maritime port definitions.

params.name: portId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific Port entity.
